description: This file defines a Java interface 'ProductTypeService' which extends a generic service interface for handling 'ProductType' entities. It declares a method to retrieve a product type based on a product type code, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

classes.name: ProductTypeService
classes.description: A Java interface extending a generic service interface to manage ProductType entities and providing a method to retrieve ProductType by code.

methods.name: getProductType
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductType based on the provided productTypeCode, may throw a ServiceException.
